inset._sourceCropWhy: human review 2026-11-13 finding 4: the old crop (x 1330-3330) put the left half of the face under the inset's left edge. The face head spans 4K x ~230-1620 (measured, skin chroma over the demo span, face_position.py); 2000x2000 at (0, 60) keeps the whole face with headroom and shoulders square for the 960x960 delivery.
inset._repositionWhy: bottom-right throughout, measured on screen-ocr.json over every inset-visible window. CODE never enters the footprint (x 2736-3696, y 1056-2016): code stops at x 3400 and the Python/kernel chips sit at x 3583-3793 above y 250, over the notebook gutter and status bar, above the inset's top. Long markdown prose lines (bulleted cells, 'Phase A:', 'Goal:') do graze the footprint's left edge by up to ~960px while they scroll, but they are transient background reading, never the read-along content the punch-ins target (all punch-in boxes sit at x < 2100), and the inset is hidden during every punch-in anyway. No corner is measurably cleaner: bottom-left is worse in every window (8-76 Mpx^2 versus bottom-right's max 9.3), and top-right is worse during the 339-746 markdown scroll (18.2 versus 9.3 Mpx^2).
